description: Add a trip to a Nomads.com member's own history: a stay in one place with a start and end date. Authenticated as the member: signed in through the connector (OAuth sign-in or an Authorization header) if set up, otherwise pass the member's username and their personal key from https://nomads.com/settings, plus the place, given EITHER as city_slug (from search_cities/get_city) OR as latitude+longitude (e.g. from a places/geocoding lookup). Coordinates within 5km of a Nomads.com city snap to it, same as the profile page's "add a trip" autocomplete; ANY other place also works - pass its city and country names with the coordinates and it is stored as-is, like the site's own trip editor.

city.description: The place name that was geocoded. Required (with country) for places that have no Nomads.com city within 5km

city_slug.description: From search_cities or get_city, e.g. lisbon-portugal. Omit if using latitude/longitude instead

country.description: The place's country name. Required with city for places without a Nomads.com city page

key.description: From https://nomads.com/settings. Omit when signed in through the connector (OAuth or Authorization header)

latitude.description: Use instead of city_slug when you only have a place name to geocode, not our slug

username.description: Omit when signed in through the connector (OAuth or Authorization header)

name: add_trip
